The original code `return int(text.replace(' ', '', 1))` would fail on inputs like "1 200 000" because it would produce "1200 000" which cannot be converted to an integer due to the remaining space.

The fix changed it to `return int(text.replace(' ', ''))` which removes all spaces, correctly converting "1 200 000" to "1200000".

This change ensures that:
- Salaries with spaces as thousands separators work correctly ("1 200 000" → 1200000)
- All existing functionality is preserved
- The pipeline.run() function now works properly in production

The fix was minimal and targeted, changing only the buggy line without affecting any other modules.", "tests_passed": true}}}]
